description: Fetch the custom domain that serves your GrowSurf program's landing pages, such as `https://refer.example.com`. Returns `domain` (`null` when none is set), `isVerified`, `verifiedAt`, and `dnsRecord`, the `CNAME` record to add at the DNS provider. This read does not check DNS; use `growsurf_verify_campaign_custom_domain` for a live check. Targets `campaignId` if supplied, otherwise `GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID`.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_get_campaign_custom_domain

outputSchema.description: The custom domain that serves the program's landing pages.

createdAt.description: When the domain was set, in epoch milliseconds. `null` when no domain is set.

dnsRecord.description: The DNS record to add at the DNS provider. `null` when no domain is set.

name.description: The hostname the record is for.

domain.description: The custom domain, such as `https://refer.example.com`, or `null` when none is set.

isVerified.description: Whether the domain's `CNAME` record pointed to `dnsRecord.value` at the last check. Landing pages load on the domain only when this is `true`.

updatedAt.description: When the domain record last changed, in epoch milliseconds. `null` when no domain is set.

verifiedAt.description: When the DNS check passed, in epoch milliseconds. `null` while unverified.

title: Get Program Custom Domain
